grades.reason: Describes atomicity PMAs (which atomic instructions a memory region supports). It says nothing about the aq/rl ordering bits on atomic operations.

grades.quote: ARM load-exclusive and store-exclusive instructions can likewise map onto their RISC-V LR and SC equivalents, but instead of placing a FENCE RW,RW in front of an LR with _aq_ set, we simply also set _rl_ instead.
grades.reason: This is an ARM-to-RVWMO mapping discussion. It does not define aq and rl. It does show them in use: LR with aq set also sets rl to get acquire-exclusive ordering, and sc.rl is used for store-release-exclusive. That gives limited indirect context about their ordering role.
